content.text: FacebookLog InLog InForgot Account?Onii-Chan's PostOnii-ChanMarch 19 at 1:30 PM · Shared with PublicJojo Steel Ball Run Debuts and Immediately Takes Top Spot on MAL JoJo’s Bizarre Adventure: Steel Ball Run (Part 7) has officially begun streaming on Netflix with a 47-minute premiere episode, and it didn’t waste any time getting hype.Within minutes, the series shot straight to the top ranking on MAL, dethroning Frieren in the top spot, proving just how massive the hype is for this long-awaited adaptation, though it’s only the first episode, so the rankings could still change in the coming days.The story follows Johnny Joestar and Gyro Zeppeli as they enter a brutal cross-country horse race filled with intense battles, bizarre abilities, and unpredictable twists.Often regarded as one of the best arcs in the entire JoJo series, fans are finally seeing Steel Ball Run come to life, and it’s already living up to expectations.All reactions:2.9K89 comments326 sharesLikeCommentMost relevant Matt LurkerIts the horse year LETS GO 6d36Bambang IrawanFrieren overrated is only judged animation not story, while Jojo is judged story and animation.6d18View all 4 repliesAniMetal ArchiveI hope they don't censor the corpse of Jesus6d8View 1 replyAlcarlo Manueltheirs a new review in frieren guys btw almost 300 accounts and you will eb surprise that in twitter someone post that frieren fans review bombing it. just look on new stats on frieren, this sbr playing innocent6d2Tristan Bern DumaplinEveryone Ganna ride a horse this year5dJuan RamirezAmazing first episode and it's going to be weekly finally Netflix did something right holy sht.6d5View 1 replyBeck TangTime to finish Stone Ocean, even though I know each one of these are not directly related to6dView all 3 repliesAlex S FlautaWhat si steel ball run just like umasume or adventure5dKhrisma NauvalTbh first episode so peak6d2Phillipe CastilloMe not having a pirated SBR6d
